# Introduction

This week provides additional time to develop, test, and refine the mini individual project before the final presentation milestone.

# Learning goals

1. Continue developing the mini individual project

2. Apply feedback to improve the project

3. Practice reproducible coding and project organization

4. Prepare the project for presentation

# Lecture - ML and AI Basics

Introduction to machine learning and artificial intelligence, with examples from agriculture (Supervised vs. unsupervised learning in agricultural contexts) (Part 2)

# Lab - Work on Mini Individual Project

Hands-on project development, troubleshooting, and instructor feedback.

# Discussion - Q&A

Peer discussion and feedback on project progress.

# Assignment

Submit a progress update on the mini individual project and ensure your latest project work and commits are submitted through Canvas.

# Looking ahead

Next week we will **present the mini projects** and complete a DISC team assessment. After that, the course will shift toward the **final team project**.
